purpose: Inventory every public reaction's current model-domain/resource blockers before an attempted broad evaluation; not a chemical-accuracy or speed result
gpu_bound_scope: Minimum simultaneous dense ERI, integer word/index arrays and coefficients in the current literal implementation. Excludes optimizer, contractions, duplicate temporaries and allocator overhead; being below this bound does not prove a case fits.
resource_response: Report unsupported/infeasible cases. Do not reduce basis, electrons, spin, reference scope or acceptance thresholds to turn failures into passes.
